data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'scierige', meaning bright, clear or shining. The name Sharyl may also have connections to the Greek word 'sharon', meaning a joyful, tranquil place. The name Sharyl carries the meaning “Shining Light, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sharyl usually hope their child will grow to embody shining light, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
